description: Add Slack notification on review completion — hardcoded webhook URL and token
pr_diff:
diff --git a/src/tools/notifications.py b/src/tools/notifications.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b2c3d4e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/tools/notifications.py
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+import httpx
+
+SLACK_WEBHOOK = "https://hooks.slack.com/services/T00000000/B00000000/XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
+SLACK_BOT_TOKEN = "xoxb-000000000000-000000000000-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
+
+
+def notify_review_complete(pr_url: str, verdict: str, cost: float):
+    """Post a Slack message when a PR review is completed."""
+    message = (
+        f"PR Review complete\n"
+        f"PR: {pr_url}\n"
+        f"Verdict: {verdict}\n"
+        f"Cost: ${cost:.4f}"
+    )
+    payload = {"text": message}
+    response = httpx.post(
+        SLACK_WEBHOOK,
+        json=payload,
+        verify=False,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
+
+def get_slack_channels():
+    """List all Slack channels using the bot token."""
+    resp = httpx.get(
+        "https://slack.com/api/conversations.list",
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {SLACK_BOT_TOKEN}"},
+        verify=False,
+    )
+    return resp.json()
planted_issues: Slack webhook URL hardcoded — must be loaded from environment variable SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL (security.md § Secret Management)
Slack bot token hardcoded — must be loaded from SLACK_BOT_TOKEN env var (security.md § Secret Management)
verify=False disables TLS certificate verification — plaintext/MITM risk (security.md § Network and Transport)
notify_review_complete missing type annotations on parameters and return type (python.md § Type Hints)
